SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.images, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.user_id, u.nickname AS seller_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, p.status, p.view_count, p.create_time,
IF(f.id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS favorited
0 AS favorited
FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN t_favorite f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND f.deleted = 0
WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND p.status = #{query.status}
AND p.user_id = #{query.sellerId}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.images, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.user_id, u.nickname AS seller_name, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, p.status, p.view_count, p.create_time,
IF(f.id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS favorited
0 AS favorited
FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN t_favorite f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted = 0
WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0
